startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Website URLs to crawl. Each is crawled breadth-first across pages on the same hostname (www-insensitive).

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: Cap on same-site HTML pages crawled (and charged) per start URL.

checkExternalLinks.title: Check external links
checkExternalLinks.description: Also check links pointing to other hostnames (checked, not crawled).

checkImagesAndAssets.title: Check images and assets
checkImagesAndAssets.description: Also check img[src], script[src] and link[rel=stylesheet][href].

includeOkLinks.title: Include working links in output
includeOkLinks.description: By default only broken links are returned. Enable to also get one row per working link.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Honor Disallow rules for user-agent * when deciding which pages to crawl. Does not affect checking already-discovered links.

maxRunMinutes.title: Max run time (minutes)
maxRunMinutes.description: Hard wall-clock budget for the whole run. As it nears, the Actor stops crawling new pages, gives in-flight checks up to 15s to finish, writes each site's summary (status "time_limit_reached" if it was cut short) and exits successfully. Pages whose links were not fully checked are never charged. Default 3 minutes keeps a first run quick; raise it (up to 1440) for large sites.
